tool.name: 3Dtrees: Raster
tool.description: forest-structure metrics, DTM, CHM and voxel counts
tool.command: cp '$point_cloud' 'input.$point_cloud.ext' && #if $area.restrict == 'yes': cp '$area.aoi' aoi.geojson && #end if mkdir -p output && Rscript /opt/foreststructure/run_julia_memory_safe.R --point-cloud 'input.$point_cloud.ext' #if $area.restrict == 'yes': --aoi-geojson aoi.geojson #end if #if str($instance_dimension): --instance-dimension '$instance_dimension' #end if --denoise '$denoising.denoise' #if $denoising.denoise == 'knn': --denoise-neighbors '$denoising.denoise_neighbors' --denoise-sigma '$denoising.denoise_sigma' #end if --tile-size '$advanced.tile_size' --grid-search-step '$advanced.grid_search_step' --voxel-resolution '$advanced.voxel_resolution' --voxel-count-resolution '$advanced.voxel_count_resolution' --dtm-resolution '$advanced.dtm_resolution' --chm-resolution '$advanced.chm_resolution' --ptd-resolution '$advanced.ptd_resolution' --vegetation-minimum-height '$advanced.vegetation_minimum_height' --gap-height-threshold '$advanced.gap_height_threshold' --minimum-tree-voxels '$advanced.minimum_tree_voxels' --apex-minimum-height '$advanced.apex_minimum_height' --minimum-tree-thickness '$advanced.minimum_tree_thickness' --minimum-occupied-layers '$advanced.minimum_occupied_layers' --raster-format '$advanced.raster_format' --output-dir output --temp-dir "\${TMPDIR:-\$_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR}"

param.name: point_cloud
param.label: Segmented point cloud
param.help: One full-resolution point cloud with at least one tree instance dimension (PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM or PredInstance_RCT); coordinates in metres, a CRS (if present) projected in metres.

param.name: restrict
param.label: Restrict to an area of interest
param.help: Without an area of interest the full point-cloud extent is analysed.

param.name: aoi
param.label: Area of interest
param.help: Polygon or MultiPolygon (GeoJSON) in the point cloud's coordinate system; it is not reprojected. Only whole tiles and voxel cells inside it are reported.

param.label: Instance dimensions
param.help: Leave empty to process every one present of PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM and PredInstance_RCT. Or type one or more of them, separated by commas without spaces; each must exist in the point cloud, otherwise the job fails.

validator.message: Enter PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM or PredInstance_RCT, separated by commas without spaces

param.label: Point-noise filtering
param.help: The kNN distance filter flags points far from their neighbours before the terrain model and metrics. Raw voxel counts always include every recorded point.

param.label: Neighbours
param.help: Nearest neighbours for each point's mean distance, counting the point itself as lidR::sor() does.

param.label: Standard deviations
param.help: Points whose mean distance exceeds the whole cloud's mean plus this many standard deviations are flagged.

section.name: advanced
section.title: Advanced parameters
section.help: Defaults are the published 3Dtrees settings. Every run records the values it used in its run provenance.

param.label: Tile size (m)
param.help: Width of the square analysis tiles.

param.label: Tile-grid search step (m)
param.help: Step of the offset search that places the tile grid. Must not exceed the tile size.

param.label: Metric voxel size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length for the tile and tree metrics.

param.label: Voxel count size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length, horizontal and vertical, of the voxel point counts.

param.label: Ground-seed resolution (m)
param.help: Seed resolution of the progressive TIN densification (PTD) ground classification.

param.label: Gap height threshold (m)
param.help: CHM height below which a cell counts as a canopy gap.

param.label: Minimum tree voxels
param.help: Occupied metric voxels a segment needs to be accepted as a tree.

param.label: Minimum apex height (m)
param.help: A tree's highest point must be strictly above this height.

param.label: Minimum tree thickness (m)
param.help: Smallest PCA extent a tree must reach.

param.label: Raster format
param.help: Format of the DTM, CHM, DSM, gap-filled CHM and voxel-count rasters. A Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF is a regular GeoTIFF that web viewers can read in parts.

param.label: Minimum occupied layers
param.help: One-metre height layers a tree must occupy.

tool.help:
# What it does
3Dtrees: Raster computes fixed-size tile metrics of forest structure (20 m tiles by default) from one segmented point cloud. It also writes a digital terrain model (DTM), a canopy height model (CHM), a digital surface model (DSM), a gap-filled CHM, full-resolution voxel point counts (0.5 m voxels by default) and provenance records. No points are subsampled, and the input file is never modified. The method and every output are described in the [tool README](https://github.com/3dTrees-earth/3Dtrees_Raster#readme).
# Input
- **Segmented point cloud**: one full-resolution LAS/LAZ or COPC file with a CRS projected in metres, or no CRS (then the products carry none), and at least one supported tree instance dimension: `PredInstance`, `PredInstance_SAT` (SegmentAnyTree), `PredInstance_FM` (ForestMamba) or `PredInstance_RCT` (RayCloudTools). - **Restrict to an area of interest** (default No): select Yes to supply a GeoJSON polygon in the point cloud's XY coordinates. Only whole tiles and voxel columns inside it are reported. - **Instance dimensions** (optional): empty processes every one of the dimensions above that the point cloud has. Or name one or more, separated by commas without spaces; the job fails if one is missing from the point cloud. - **Point-noise filtering** (default None): the kNN distance filter flags points whose mean distance to their 8 nearest neighbours exceeds the whole cloud's mean plus two standard deviations. The terrain model, canopy models and tile metrics then use the remaining points. - **Advanced parameters**: tile size, voxel sizes, raster resolutions and the tree-acceptance thresholds. Keep the defaults to stay comparable with other 3Dtrees products.
CPU, memory and scratch space come from the Galaxy job allocation.
# Outputs
Per instance dimension (collections named by dimension):
- **Tile metrics**: one row per tile with vegetation density, height statistics, vertical complexity, canopy roughness and tree statistics. - **Segment diagnostics**: one row per segment with the tree-acceptance checks, apex position, crown area and voxel volume. - **Tiles**: the tile metrics as GeoJSON polygons.
Shared:
- **DTM**, **CHM**, **gap-filled CHM** and **DSM** as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (plain GeoTIFF on request), and a PNG tile overview. - **Voxel point counts**: occupied voxels as CSV, a multiband UInt32 GeoTIFF (band b holds heights from (b-1)×s to b×s above the DTM for voxel size s), a validity raster (0 excluded, 1 valid, 2 invalid DTM), the same voxels as a COPC point cloud for 3D viewers, and grid metadata. Counts include every recorded point, also those flagged as noise. - **Rejected noise points** and a **Denoising report** (with the filter only). - **Run provenance** and **Analysis footprint** records.
